description: Diagnostic comparison of legacy atom_per_generator_volumes (H_3 weights) vs proper per_generator_V_hat_3A (H_{3A} weights) for atoms A = 1..6. Companion to PR #1238 audit. Quantifies the legacy bug's per-generator V̂_full impact.
interpretation: A = 1: legacy H_3 weights correct (Δ = 0 expected). A > 1: legacy uses wrong H_3 weights for H_{3A} braid; Δ measures bug's per-generator V̂_full impact. Downstream mass-formula predictions inherit this error.
next_steps: Full migration sweep (separate PR): (1) update 15+ caller scripts to use per_generator_V_hat_3A; (2) regenerate affected witnesses; (3) compare before/after PDG-difference per atom.
